flags.title: 11 ha cleared after the EUDR cut-off (small)
flags.text: Satellite monitoring mapped one small clearing here in 2021. It may be authorised under Brazilian law, so domestic and Türkiye-bound buyers can accept these animals, but the EU regulation has a zero-deforestation cut-off: they cannot go into an EU-bound lot.

flags.title: Resells animals after a median of 30 days
flags.text: 100% of lots are resold within 45 days. Its suppliers look clean, so this may be a legitimate trader: kept on watch, not blocked.

flags.title: 360 ha cleared after the EUDR cut-off
flags.text: Satellite monitoring mapped 4 new clearings inside this ranch in 2021, 2022, 2025. Cattle that spent any time here cannot be sold into the EU after 30 Dec 2026, and clearing at this scale in the region is almost always illegal.

flags.title: Pasture inside Indigenous land (mock outline)
flags.text: The ranch boundary sits inside a legally protected territory where commercial cattle ranching is not allowed. Every animal born or kept here is tainted.

flags.title: Unusual trading pattern
flags.text: The anomaly model scores this ranch's buying pattern (many small lots from many sellers) as unusual for its size. No hard rule is broken; kept on watch.

flags.title: Resells animals after a median of 11 days
flags.text: 100% of the lots it bought were sold on within 45 days, far too fast to fatten them (real fattening takes 4 to 12 months). Combined with flagged suppliers, this is the signature of an intermediary that "washes" animals before a slaughterhouse or ship sees them.

flags.title: 100% of animals bought trace back to flagged ranches
flags.text: Following the permits upstream, 100% of the head this ranch bought originate on ranches with post-2020 clearing, protected-area pasture, an embargo or impossible births. A check of direct suppliers alone would not see this.

flags.title: Declares 1,566 calves from 965 cows
flags.text: Biology caps calving at about 85 calves per 100 breeding cows per year, so at most 820 births are possible here. The other 746 calves have no possible mother on this ranch: they are animals from somewhere else being given a clean birth certificate.
